about: probe 43 (audit/harness/probes/43-stale-windows.mjs): each window of probe 08's list left open while one thing in the world changed, set beside the same window opened fresh. A reading, not a verdict.

changes.what: the time of day set to another (clock.mjs setClock)
a Monokuma's Despair moved by one (despair.mjs setDespair)
the Overflow's count raised by one (overflow.mjs addOverflow)
a student's Hope moved by one (the actor's update)
a student's Health marked by one (the actor's update)
a student's actions left changed by one (actions.mjs setActions)
a tool given to a student (inventory.mjs grantItem)
a Truth Bullet given to a student (truth-bullets.mjs createTruthBullet)
a Remnant placed on the scene (remnants.mjs placeRemnant, setRemnantPublic)
a Remnant's token moved by hand to another room (a plain token update, no module function)
a deduction added to the chapter's case in the GMs' store (case-schema.mjs setCaseNode)
a student killed, the death public (chapter.mjs killCharacter), and revived
an Eclipse started (eclipse.mjs startEclipse) and ended without moving the clock
